Koegaki 1.12.3

  • On the Mac, cleanup now reads a word that opens with an accent or vowel mark as one word, as Koegaki on Windows does.
  • On Windows, from this version on, after Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone, an app update installed later opens the new version instead of leaving it waiting unseen in the background.
  • On Windows, when Koegaki restarts itself, for a model update or to recover the microphone, it now gives changes made in Settings time to save first. If a change cannot be saved when you choose Restart now for a model update, Koegaki says so and does not restart.
  • On Windows, if Koegaki restarts itself for a model update or to recover the microphone and the new copy cannot launch, the one you were using now keeps running instead of closing.
